articles.title: Delhi hotel fire: Probe narrows focus on blocked roof exit, heaters, norm violations and ownership tangle
articles.summary: Delhi Police, investigating a fire-hit hotel in South Delhi's Malviya Nagar, uncovered significant safety violations. Their probe found the building's roof exit blocked, hindering escape routes. Crucially, cooking heaters were also discovered in use within the premises. These findings highlight serious concerns regarding fire safety compliance and potential factors contributing to the incident, underscoring the vital need for strict adherence to safety regulations.

articles.title: The $13 billion carrier with a plumbing problem is home. Now come the costly repairs
articles.summary: The USS Gerald R. Ford, the U.S. Navy's newest aircraft carrier, has returned to port with its 4,600 sailors after a deployment. It is now slated for essential repairs and upgrades, including its problematic sewage system. This maintenance highlights the continuous operational readiness requirements and logistical support for advanced naval assets, crucial for sustaining global defence capabilities.

articles.title: Revisiting The Importance of the Battle of Midway
articles.summary: The Battle of Midway is a cornerstone of American naval lore, akin to Salamis or Trafalgar. This pivotal World War II naval engagement saw the US Navy achieve a decisive victory against the Imperial Japanese Navy, fundamentally altering the Pacific War's trajectory. It underscores the critical role of intelligence, strategic planning, and naval air power, offering enduring lessons in military strategy and valor.
